title: From detectability of abstract linear systems to exponential output-to-state stability and back
summary: We study exponential output-to-state stability (eOSS) of linear infinite-dimensional systems in Banach spaces with bounded output operators. It is shown that eOSS is equivalent to the existence of a coercive eOSS Lyapunov function in implication form. Also exponential detectability guarantees the existence of a coercive eOSS Lyapunov function in dissipation form and therefore eOSS. Counterexamples demonstrate that the converse implications fail in general: exponential zero-detectability does not imply eOSS, eOSS does not imply the existence of an eOSS Lyapunov function in dissipation form,…
